6ab074afb3c3763832de01e1.name: Instructions (open this card)
6ab074afb3c3763832de01e1.desc:
Use this board as the single source of truth for GK Cakes work.

**How the statuses work:**
- **Backlog** = not ready yet, still being defined, or waiting for decisions
- **Ready** = clearly defined and can start immediately
- **In Progress** = someone or the AI Agent is actively working on it
- **Review** = needs checking, testing, or approval
- **Done** = finished and accepted

**How the AI Agent should move cards:**
- Put unclear ideas in Backlog
- Move to Ready only when the task is specific enough to start
- Move to In Progress when work begins
- Move to Review when the work is complete enough to check
- Move to Done after approval

Keep card titles short and specific so the agent can identify them easily. You can archive this card later if the workflow is already familiar.
